key_findings: Human DRG contains OPRM1-positive (peptidergic-like, Nav1.8-enriched) and OPRM1-negative (non-peptidergic-like, Nav1.9, TRPV1 and P2X3-enriched) nociceptor populations.
OPRK1 is expressed mainly in satellite glial cells, not neurons (1.6% of neurons) in human DRG; OPRD1 and OPRL1 are expressed at low levels in OPRM1+ nociceptors.
